name: Abuzittin'in Maceraları II: İz Peşinde
storyline: Abuzittin's second adventure begins with the kidnapping of Murat, a fellow soldier who had caused him trouble in the first game. Since Murat's kidnapping falls on Abuzittin's shoulders, it's up to him. While trying to find Murat, Abuzittin gets caught in the middle of two rival gangs and things get complicated as the events unfold. A big surprise awaits Abuzittin again.
summary: This game starts in fullscreen. “Çıkış” in the menu or Alt+F4 shortcut will exit the game. In the intro, the developer states that the game “is sutiable for ages 11 and up”, “contains unfavourable behaviors” and “contains vulgarity”.Full Turkish solution of the game can be found in Extras.
